Tom Holland will perform all dance scenes in the Fred Astaire biopic.

Tom Holland plans to shoot all dance sequences in single, continuous takes to mirror Fred Astaire's style. He described his first rehearsals as a mix of excitement and absolute dread. The film is in development with Paul King directing and Steven Levenson writing the script.
